allocation_impact: The decoder refuses a payload over 41 bytes on length before reading any field; the largest valid intent (a 16-byte identity, a u64::MAX generation and two 5-byte zigzag sint32 coordinates, 18 + 11 + 6 + 6) is exactly 41 bytes. The result payload is at most 4 bytes (max_result_payload_bytes). Non-durable; nothing is allocated past the bound.
notes: WORLD-INTERACTION-0 §10.1 and §12, amended from 32 to 41 bytes by the owner on 2026-10-14 (WORLDINT-WIRE-1, #2094). Mirrors max_payload_bytes of command type 15. Registered by WORLDINT-WIRE-1.
